items.description: Report does not give the salt hashing formula or exact inputs, so the equality between pairFor()'s predicted address and createPair()'s actual address cannot be derived from the four-vs-two address counts; the address equality is carried as a symbolic comparison rather than a computed relation.
Report does not state who triggers totalFeeShare becoming zero or who calls endRewards().

Report states pairFor() uses two addresses while createPair() uses four, but gives no salt inputs or hashing formula, so the predicted-vs-actual pair address equality is bound only as symbolic address equality, not as a computable derivation.
